title: Mendenhall River instantaneous discharge, 1986–2026
description: The available instantaneous discharge record, with the Suicide Basin outburst-flood era shown in more detail.
source: U.S. Geological Survey National Water Information System

provenance.querySummary: Annual instantaneous-value requests for parameter 00060, 1986-01-01 through 2026-09-05.
provenance.timeEncoding: Continuous timestamps are ISO 8601 Alaska wall times with explicit UTC offsets, converted with America/Juneau. USGS UTC instants were retained during validation.
provenance.approvalStatus: USGS P qualifiers are represented as Provisional; other published instantaneous values are represented as Approved.

processing.method: Time buckets retain the first, minimum, maximum, and last observation; gaps are explicit nulls.
